+++ buggy.sv
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 			begin 
 				match <= 1'b0;
 			end
-		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001)
+		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0101)

claims.violated_requirement: The output match should be asserted when the shift register matches 8'b0111_0001, but the mutant asserts it for 8'b0111_0101 instead. This will cause a mismatch when the input sequence produces the pattern 8'b0111_0101.
claims.spec_basis: The output `match` should be asserted (logic 1) whenever the value of the shift register `a_tem` matches the specific 8-bit pattern `8'b0111_0001`.
